## Docker Context Privacy

The Docker context check requires these `.dockerignore` patterns:

- `.git/`
- `.pixi/`
- `.repo-graph/`
- `.env`
- `.env.*`
- `graph.json`
- `config/*.local.yaml`
- `config/private*.yaml`
